report.title: Portable report export
report.summary: A focused implementation plan for producing a durable, shareable HTML report from normalized data.

body: Users need a portable record of a completed analysis. The current screen can be printed, but its transient UI state is not a durable document contract.
The export should derive from normalized result data, remain readable without the application, and expose its provenance.

items.title: Selected
items.desc: Render normalized blocks into the existing portable HTML report engine.

items.title: Deferred
items.desc: A server-side PDF service can wait until the document contract is proven.

steps.title: Normalize data
steps.desc: Map application results into the report schema.

steps.title: Render HTML
steps.desc: Inject the JSON into the canonical template.

steps.title: Share
steps.desc: Keep the file local or publish it to the configured CDN.

rows.label: Input
rows.desc: One JSON document containing report metadata and supported blocks.

rows.label: Output
rows.desc: One responsive HTML file with the data and rendering engine embedded.

rows.label: Publishing
rows.desc: Optional upload of the report and referenced local media to an S3-compatible CDN.

rows.label: Portable
rows.desc: The report opens as a standalone HTML document.

rows.label: Canonical
rows.desc: Only block types from the canonical block catalog are used.

rows.label: Publishable
rows.desc: Local media is rewritten to public URLs when publishing.

items: Decide whether PDF export is worth adding after the HTML workflow is used in practice.
